{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]]|the [[Pilot/Legends|general occupation]] for flying a ship}}
'''Pilot''' was a rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]], directly above that of [[Apprentice (Black Bha'lir)|Apprentice]]. The rank was bestowed after a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on Apprentices who had proven their worth and demonstrated an understanding of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] business. The majority of the Black Bha'lir's members were Pilots, with many of them not moving beyond the rank because they lacked the business acumen to do more than fly a starship.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
